# The Record card next to a server's scoreboard sidebar (1280x720 at GUI scale 3 = 426x240): with 10 sidebar lines a
# right card has no room and fades (before, it dropped onto the hunger bar); with 3 lines it sits above the sidebar.
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch> -f script=.github/checks/card-sidebar.txt

cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
sleep 6
set recordCard true
set cardLyrics true
set cardCorner BOTTOM_RIGHT
guiscale 3
sleep 3
shot card-br-plain
cmd scoreboard objectives add sky dummy
cmd scoreboard objectives setdisplay sidebar sky
cmd scoreboard players set Line01 sky 1
cmd scoreboard players set Line02 sky 2
cmd scoreboard players set Line03 sky 3
cmd scoreboard players set Line04 sky 4
cmd scoreboard players set Line05 sky 5
cmd scoreboard players set Line06 sky 6
cmd scoreboard players set Line07 sky 7
cmd scoreboard players set Line08 sky 8
cmd scoreboard players set Line09 sky 9
cmd scoreboard players set Line10 sky 10
sleep 3
shot card-br-side10
cmd scoreboard players reset Line04 sky
cmd scoreboard players reset Line05 sky
cmd scoreboard players reset Line06 sky
cmd scoreboard players reset Line07 sky
cmd scoreboard players reset Line08 sky
cmd scoreboard players reset Line09 sky
cmd scoreboard players reset Line10 sky
sleep 3
shot card-br-side3
set cardCorner TOP_RIGHT
sleep 3
shot card-tr-side3
cmd scoreboard players set Line04 sky 4
cmd scoreboard players set Line05 sky 5
cmd scoreboard players set Line06 sky 6
cmd scoreboard players set Line07 sky 7
cmd scoreboard players set Line08 sky 8
cmd scoreboard players set Line09 sky 9
cmd scoreboard players set Line10 sky 10
sleep 3
shot card-tr-side10
